description:
Ø Java experience – OOPS concepts, Design Patterns, Data Structures, Multithreading. (Good to have Java8 experience) 
 Ø Hands-on experience in Spring Boot, KAFKA. Good to know about AKKA, Gemfire, Jasper reports, Websocket implementation. 
 Ø Good understanding (hands-on experience preferable) of frameworks like – Spring, Struts, Hibernate. 
 Ø Web services experience – REST and SOAP. Good to know about EJBs. 
 Ø Hands-on experience in build(ing) scripts like – Maven, Gradle 
 Ø Experience in using version controlling tools like – SVN, GIT 
 Ø Database hands-on experience. Oracle is preferable. 
 Ø Security and Authentication implementation. Using Spring, LDAP is preferable. Good to know about TLS 1.2 and related APIs. 
 Ø Experience in working on CI and CD tools like – Jenkins, Rundeck 
 Ø Experience in using collaborating and tracking tools like – JIRA, Confluence 
 Ø Good to know about Microservice architecture and usage of (Spring)cloud for the same. 
 Ø Good to know UI side technologies like – HTML, Angular, JS, JQuery. 
 Ø Good to know about networking concepts like nodes, clustering, load balancing. 

 Minimum 7 Years of experience in Java. 
 Kafka experience is preferred one (atleast knowledge)
 


 Client - MindTree Corporation
